comments.text: What makes Borneo so extraordinary is that life there is still shaped by one of the oldest rainforest ecosystems on Earth. 🌿 From Indigenous communities and river settlements to caves, orangutans and remote jungle interiors, the island feels like a place where human life and wilderness are still deeply intertwined.
